prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star comp for the desktop Course Library of a local web app named Dolphin.
Primary request: a polished, minimalist software interface inspired by the Flexoki color-system aesthetic: warm paper-white #FFFCF0 background, softly layered neutral surfaces #F2F0E5, near-black #100F0F text, quiet gray rules, restrained semantic blue #205EA6 and teal #24837B, rare red only for error. This is a digital workspace, not a desk, library, notebook, paper texture, or physical-object simulation.
Scene/backdrop: full desktop web app viewport, 1440 by 900 proportion.
Composition/framing: a 56px pale-gray vertical navigation rail on the left with a small abstract Dolphin mark and three simple line icons; a slim top bar with “Dolphin” on the left and a discreet local-only status on the right. The main region has a wide, calm heading “Your courses” with the supporting line “Courses are stored on this machine.” A quiet primary action, “New course”, sits at upper right. Below, a single-column structured list with three course rows, each row showing the Topic, Goal, a compact Course State label, lesson progress, and a fine horizontal progress rule. The first row is active with a low-contrast neutral fill; no rounded cards and no shadows. A small bottom note reads “Uses your existing AI subscription.”
Style/medium: crisp browser UI mockup, subtle sans-serif interface typography with a compact monospace face for metadata, generous whitespace, exact grid alignment, hairline separators. Minimal and calm; hierarchy comes from spacing, type, and quiet contrast.
Text (verbatim): "Dolphin", "Your courses", "Courses are stored on this machine.", "New course", "System design", "Design reliable distributed systems", "In progress", "4 of 8 lessons", "Python for data work", "Build practical analysis skills", "Ready", "0 of 6 lessons", "Understanding containers", "Learn Docker from first principles", "Complete", "6 of 6 lessons", "Uses your existing AI subscription."
Constraints: recognizable software product UI, clean responsive proportions, accessible contrast, no fake metrics, no dashboards, no large illustration.
Avoid: simulated library, shelf, book, notebook, wood, brass, paper grain, fabric, skeuomorphism, glassmorphism, gradients, bento grid, rounded cards, decorative ornament, watermark, device frame.
